items.headline: Futures Signal Continued Volatility as Geopolitical Tensions and Rate Hike Concerns Weigh on Markets
items.summary: US stock futures are showing volatility this Wednesday, September 2, 2026, following a downturn in major indices on Tuesday. The market sentiment remains cautious amid rising bond yields, elevated oil prices due to renewed US-Iran hostilities, and anticipation of central bank rate hikes. Investors are closely monitoring upcoming economic data, including ADP private payrolls and the Federal Reserve's Beige Book, alongside key earnings reports.

items.headline: US Manufacturing PMI Shows Continued Expansion in August
items.summary: The US ISM Manufacturing PMI eased slightly to 54.6% in August 2026 from 55.6% in July, marking the eighth consecutive month of expansion for the manufacturing sector. This data remains a key focus for the Federal Reserve as it prepares for its September meeting.

items.headline: Fed Rate Hike Odds Increase After Hawkish Remarks
items.summary: Expectations for a September Fed rate hike have risen to nearly 60% following Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole, where he reaffirmed the 2% inflation target. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for September 15-16, 2026.

items.headline: Oil Prices Surge Amid Renewed US-Iran Hostilities
items.summary: Crude oil prices advanced significantly, with Brent crude trading at $94.90 per barrel and US crude at $90.34 a barrel, due to escalating US-Iran conflict and concerns over energy supplies, particularly in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits Multi-Year High
items.summary: The benchmark U.S. 10-year Treasury note yield rose to 4.814% on Wednesday, reaching its highest level since November 2023, as investors demanded increased returns amidst elevated inflation and growing government debt.

items.headline: Snowflake ($SNOW) Earnings Eyed for AI Data Workload Insights

items.headline: Market Sees Rotation from AI Mega-Caps to Value and Energy
items.summary: 2026 has witnessed a significant capital rotation, with money shifting from a concentrated few AI mega-cap stocks into energy, industrials, materials, staples, and small caps, easing crowded positioning in the AI space.
